_comment: Voice roster for the evaluation corpus, one per language.
IMPORTANT — these are NOT currently persona-matched, which confounds any
cross-language prosody comparison. Jules (fr) is tagged 'Enthusiastic, Expressive'
while es/de are 'Helpful, Attentive' and en is 'Confident'. An expressive persona
raises F0 variance for reasons unrelated to model quality, so the monotone detector
(f0_semitone_std) reads differently for French than for the others.
The catalog also contains two tag generations: older voices use
Mixing generations adds a second, less visible confound.
Before the 20x5 parallel corpus run, either (a) re-pick all five voices matched on
persona and tag generation, or (b) keep these and treat cross-language prosody as
uncontrolled in the writeup. Option (a) is cheap and strictly better.

pt._note: Portugal (country=pt), not Brazil. The catalog is majority pt-BR; European Portuguese was chosen to match the native-region convention used for es/fr. Neutral persona deliberately avoids inflating F0 variance.
